text:
emma (Support): Customer outage report — per-model throughput sparklines in Console are blank/flat since last night's metrics tag migration. They still see metrics in Prometheus but Grafana panels show nothing. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/REDACTED :warning:

emma (Support): Quick check: curl'ing exporter shows it now exposes label `model_id` instead of `model_name`. Repro steps below.

emma (Support): Repro steps:
1) Console > Models > pick any model
2) Time range 1h
3) Panels empty (sparkline area grey).

Example curl:```curl -s http://metrics-exporter-1.eu-west.internal:9100/metrics | grep model```
returns lines like:
`model_requests_total{model_id="gpt-2-medium",region="eu-west"} 123
`
(no `model_name` label present)

raj (Eng Platform): Thanks, useful. Can you paste the dashboard UID or panel query? Also which Prometheus scrape job is scraping this exporter?

emma (Support): Dashboard UID: `models-overview-v2`. Exporter: `metrics-exporter-1` in eu-west. Prometheus target shows job `redwood/exporters`.

olivia (SRE): Grafana alert `model-qps-missing` fired at 2025-07-05T03:12:04Z. Noted. :point_up:

nate (Eng Runtime): Sounds like a label rename broke our dashboard regexes (they expect `model_name`). Short term: add a compatibility relabel in Prometheus mapping `model_id` -> `model_name`, or update dashboards to accept `model_id`. Which is quicker for infra?

raj (Eng Platform): Prefer relabel on Prometheus as a stopgap so we don't change many dashboards. I'll draft relabel_config.

raj (Eng Platform): Draft relabel snippet (will validate before applying):
```yaml
- source_labels: [model_id]
  target_label: model_name
  action: replace
```
This will create `model_name` with the value from `model_id`.

raj (Eng Platform): Also: was the exporter bumped without migration notes? @emma can you confirm image tag from the customer's cluster?

emma (Support): Exporter image tag: `redwood/metrics-exporter:2025.7.4` (deployed 2025-07-05 02:00 UTC).

olivia (SRE): To unblock customers ASAP we can apply the relabel on Prometheus for the `redwood/exporters` job and then update dashboards to include `label_values(model_name)` OR fallback to `coalesce(model_name, model_id)` where supported. Workaround steps posted in infra runbook.

nate (Eng Runtime): I'll also open a patch to the exporter to add `model_name` alongside the new `model_id` (backcompat). Target: ship within ~2 hours, then we can remove relabel later. I'll tag eng-oncall.

grafana-bot: alert resolved — `model-qps-missing` at 2025-07-05T03:30:12Z (silenced by olivia (SRE)). :white_check_mark:

emma (Support): Customer escalated to P2 earlier, they've been informed we're applying a hotfix and relabel. Will update when Prometheus change is live.

raj (Eng Platform): I'll also add a short note to the metrics migration guide reminding devs to preserve backward-compatible label names or provide a migration window. :thumbsup:

emma (Support): Thanks everyone — adding ticket #INC-2025-771 to track follow-up (dashboards to accept both labels + exporter patch).
